title: Upcoming Knowledge Portal focus group: help us help you!
summary: Join our focus group on December 8th, 2022 to give us feedback on how we can help you understand and use the advanced tools available on the KPs.
bodyHtml:
We have switched our regular presentation next week (December 8) from a webinar to a focus group because, after receiving so many valuable suggestions at last month’s focus group, we want to hear even more from you! In next week’s discussion, we’ll talk about some of the more advanced tools offered by the Knowledge Portals, such as GAIT, the Gene Finder, and the Signal Sifter. We want to hear from you what you need in order to understand them better and and use them more often.

Please join us on Thursday December 8th, from 12-1pm EST. Joining instructions are below and are also embedded in this flyer. Please circulate the flyer to interested colleagues!

We won’t be sharing the recording of this session, but if you can’t attend and have suggestions, please reach out to our helpdesk at help@kp4cd.org. We hope to see you next week!
